title: Parker Washington 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks #152 Penn State RC Nittany Lions
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card features Parker Washington, a rookie player for the Penn State Nittany Lions in the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) football league. The card is made of high-quality card stock and is a standard size for easy display. It is part of the 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks set, with a card number of 152. 

The card has a Prizm parallel/variety and is in English language. It was manufactured in the United States by Panini. This item is perfect for any sports fan or collector looking to add to their collection. Get your hands on this rare and valuable card today!
